script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage says Baasha fortified Ramah; it does not say he built a wall.
The explanation is flat and repeats that there were no ships without adding personality.
The specific-address line is generic and adds little to the explanation.
It asserts what would have happened if Ben-hadad had kept the treaty and presents that speculation as Asa's reason.
The text does not say Baasha was building a wall or that it was half done.
The passage says Asa built up Geba and Mizpah with the materials; it does not say they became walls.
Hanani speaks of war from now on, but the explanation presents a season of fights as something Asa has already experienced.
The text says Asa put Hanani in prison, but does not say he was placed in a cell.
Saying Asa's anger did not stop at the seer attributes his oppression of the people to anger. The passage does not give a reason for the oppression.
Saying he will not joke about the passage comments on how Papa tells the story.
Even as a guess, saying Asa looked elsewhere first suggests he might have sought the LORD afterward. The passage says he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.
